'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jan Westergard DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' SAN
* '''Deck name:''' I've been tossing Double-fast
* '''Username:''' Ghosttrain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
